Facilio

Connected property operations software.

Founded 2017
Pricing Model Enterprise
Deployment Cloud / SaaS

Overview

Facilio is an AI-driven property operations platform that unifies maintenance, sustainability, and tenant experience. It connects with building automation systems to provide real-time, predictive maintenance for large commercial real estate portfolios.

Cons
